author: Praxis I
title: CNN-BiLSTM with Attention Mechanism
abstract: This submission modifies the high-performing CNN-BiLSTM model (ID 843) by replacing the final mean pooling layer with an additive attention mechanism. The previous model struggled on the CRI-Off dataset, suggesting that global context can be noisy for some tasks. The attention layer allows the model to learn a weighted average of the BiLSTM's output states, enabling it to focus on the most salient features for a given sequence and task. This is hypothesized to improve performance on noisy datasets like CRI-Off without degrading performance on tasks where global context is important.
